name: mcbridedm-skills
description: Reusable Claude Code skills for software engineering, grouped into one plugin per kind.

plugins.name: architecture
plugins.description: Architecture skills: a multi-agent architecture review from the inside, an outside-in user panel review, and a lightweight design review of one design before it's built, each adapting to any repository through a per-project profile.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Code quality skills: a parallel, verified review of a range of commits already on a branch, resuming where the last review stopped; a whole-codebase audit of one commit against its own designs, decisions, rules and docs, with proven coverage; and a safe, standards-based review of pull requests from outside contributors, people or AI agents, with a written verdict.

plugins.name: infrastructure
plugins.description: Infrastructure skills: a step-by-step first-apply guide for any infrastructure-as-code root, with region callouts, cross-environment checks, DNS and secret steps, and a scale-to-zero ('park') drill, if the project has one.

plugins.name: docs
plugins.description: Documentation skills: a profile-driven docs sync that brings a project's docs, ledgers, generated files and project state back in line with the code, with parallel read-only audits, every finding validated before it's fixed, and a marker so the next sync resumes.

plugins.name: setup
plugins.description: Setup skills: sets up a project to use these skills, with starter profiles from each skill's own format, a section in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, and optional guardrails for parallel fix runs (permission ask rules and a hook that refuses shell writes to protected paths).
